description.english: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
description.french: Au matin de sa vie, la graine sur son dos lui fournit les éléments dont il a besoin pour grandir.

description.english: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
description.french: Lorsque le bourgeon sur son dos éclot, il répand un doux parfum pour célébrer sa floraison.

description.english: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
description.french: Le parfum de sa fleur se fait plus pénétrant les lendemains de pluie. Cela appâte les autres Pokémon.

description.english: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
description.french: La flamme de sa queue symbolise sa vitalité. Elle est intense quand il est en bonne santé.

description.english: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
description.french: La nuit, la queue ardente du Reptincel brille comme une étoile dans son repaire montagneux.

description.english: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
description.french: On raconte que la flamme du Dracaufeu s’intensifie après un combat difficile.

description.english: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
description.french: Il se réfugie dans sa carapace et réplique en éclaboussant l’ennemi à la première occasion.

description.english: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
description.french: On prétend qu’il vit 10 000 ans. Sa queue duveteuse est un symbole de longévité populaire.

description.english: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
description.french: Les trombes d’eau projetées par les canons de sa carapace peuvent percer le métal le plus résistant.

description.english: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description.french: Ses antennes rouges libèrent une puanteur qui repousse l’ennemi. Il grandit par mues régulières.

description.english: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
description.french: Son corps frêle est protégé par sa carapace d’acier. Il encaisse les coups durs en attendant d’évoluer.

description.english: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
description.french: Il raffole du nectar des fleurs. Il est capable de repérer la plus petite quantité de pollen.

description.english: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
description.french: Il mange chaque jour son poids en feuilles. Il utilise l’aiguillon sur sa tête pour repousser l’ennemi.

description.english: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
description.french: Il se cache sous les feuilles et les branches pour fuir les prédateurs en attendant d’évoluer.

description.english: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
description.french: Il virevolte rapidement autour de l’ennemi et frappe de son dard empoisonné avant de décamper.

description.english: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description.french: Ce Pokémon docile préfère éviter le combat. Toutefois, il se montre très féroce quand on l’agresse.

description.english: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
description.french: Il survole son vaste territoire en quête d’une proie avant de fondre sur elle toutes griffes en avant.

description.english: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
description.french: En battant des ailes de toutes ses forces, Roucarnage génère une rafale à en déraciner les arbres.

description.english: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
description.french: D’une prudence extrême, sa nature robuste lui permet de s’adapter à tous les terrains.

description.english: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
description.french: Il grignote sans cesse pour apaiser la poussée de ses crocs. Il peut transpercer un mur de parpaings.

description.english: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
description.french: Il fait battre vigoureusement ses petites ailes pour voler et cherche à manger dans l’herbe avec le bec.

description.english: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
description.french: Il a assez d’énergie pour voler toute la journée avec ses grandes ailes. Il frappe de son bec acéré.

description.english: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
description.french: Il se faufile dans l’herbe sans un bruit et frappe dans le dos quand sa proie s’y attend le moins.

description.english: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
description.french: Il utilise la marque sur son ventre pour intimider l’ennemi. Il étouffe l’ennemi pétrifié par la peur.

description.english: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
description.french: Il lui arrive de remettre d’aplomb un Pikachu allié en lui envoyant une décharge électrique.

description.english: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
description.french: Il se protège des décharges grâce à sa queue qui dissipe l’électricité dans le sol.

description.english: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
description.french: Il vit sur des terres arides épargnées par la pluie. Il se roule en boule pour se protéger.

description.english: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
description.french: Il se met en boule pour percuter l’ennemi. Ses épines aiguisées font beaucoup de dégâts.

description.english: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description.french: Bien qu’il rechigne à se battre, une goutte du poison sécrété par ses piquants peut s’avérer fatale.

description.english: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
description.french: Ce Pokémon dresse ses piquants en cas de danger. Ils poussent moins vite que ceux de Nidorino.

description.english: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
description.french: Son corps est recouvert d’écailles solides. Il donnera sa vie pour secourir les petits de son terrier.

description.english: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
description.french: Il jauge le terrain en laissant ses oreilles dépasser de l’herbe. Il se défend avec sa corne toxique.

description.english: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
description.french: D’un tempérament violent, il empale l’ennemi sur sa corne qui distille un poison puissant.

description.english: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
description.french: Un coup de sa puissante queue peut briser un poteau téléphonique comme une allumette.

description.english: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
description.french: On dit que ceux qui voient danser un groupe de Mélofée sous la pleine lune connaîtront un grand bonheur.

description.english: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
description.french: Il est très farouche et se laisse rarement approcher. De plus, il détecte les sons à plus d’1 km.

description.english: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
description.french: Il envoie des boules de feu. Avec l’âge, ses six queues en forment de nouvelles.

description.english: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
description.french: On raconte que ses neuf queues détiennent un pouvoir mystique. Il peut vivre pendant mille ans.

description.english: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
description.french: Lorsqu’il roule ses grands yeux ronds, il entonne une berceuse qui endort son auditoire.

description.english: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
description.french: Sa fourrure est d’une douceur incomparable au toucher. Il peut gonfler en aspirant de l’air.

description.english: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
description.french: Il se repère dans l’espace grâce aux ultrasons émis par sa gueule.

description.english: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
description.french: Ses crocs acérés et creux peuvent pénétrer la plus épaisse des peaux et sucer le sang de la victime.

description.english: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
description.french: En journée, il plante ses pieds-racines dans le sol. La nuit, il se promène en semant des graines.

description.english: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
description.french: L’odeur du nectar de sa bouche est si répugnante qu’elle agresse les narines à deux kilomètres.

description.english: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description.french: Ses pétales sont les plus grands du monde. Il marche en répandant un pollen extrêmement allergène.

description.english: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
description.french: Des champignons appelés “tochukaso” poussent sur son dos. Ils évoluent avec le Paras hôte.

description.english: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
description.french: Un champignon parasite plus gros que Parasect contrôle son corps. Il répand des spores empoisonnées.

description.english: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
description.french: Ses grands yeux sont en fait des amas d’yeux minuscules. La nuit, il est attiré par la lumière.

description.english: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
description.french: Il répand ses écailles poudreuses en battant des ailes. Elles sont toxiques au toucher.

description.english: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
description.french: Un Pokémon qui vit sous terre. Habitué aux souterrains, il fuit la lumière du jour.

description.english: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
description.french: Ses trois têtes creusent le sol à tour de rôle. Il peut atteindre des profondeurs de 100 kilomètres.

description.english: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
description.french: Son regard s’anime à la vue d’un objet brillant. C’est un Pokémon nocturne.

description.english: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
description.french: Un Pokémon très snob. La taille du joyau qui orne son front alimente bien des débats parmi ses fans.

description.english: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
description.french: Ses pouvoirs déconcertants et mystérieux lui font subir de constantes migraines.

description.english: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
description.french: Ses membres palmés et son corps parfaitement adapté font de lui un nageur exceptionnel.

description.english: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
description.french: Ils vivent en colonies sylvestres. Quand un Férosinge s’énerve, toute la colonie suit son exemple.

description.english: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
description.french: Il grogne quand on le toise, rugit quand on s’enfuit et devient fou de rage quand on le frappe.

description.english: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
description.french: Un Pokémon très loyal. Il restera immobile jusqu’à ce que son Dresseur lui donne un ordre.

description.english: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
description.french: Son port altier et son attitude fière ont depuis longtemps conquis le cœur des hommes.

description.english: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
description.french: Sa peau est si mince qu’on voit ses organes internes. Il tient à peine sur ses nouveaux pieds.

description.english: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
description.french: La spirale qui orne son ventre ondule doucement. Celui qui la fixe est saisi d’une étrange torpeur.

description.english: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
description.french: Il possède de sacrés biscoteaux. Il peut parcourir sans relâche l’Océan Pacifique.

description.english: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
description.french: L’utilisation de ses pouvoirs mentaux le fatigue tellement qu’il dort 18 heures par jour.

description.english: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
description.french: Il fixe sa cuillère d’argent afin de concentrer son esprit et d’émettre un maximum d’ondes alpha.

description.english: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
description.french: On dit que les cuillères qu’il tient en permanence ont été créées par la puissance de son esprit.

description.english: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
description.french: Malgré sa petite taille, sa force lui permet de soulever plusieurs Racaillou à la fois.

description.english: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
description.french: Il soulève les plus lourdes charges avec plaisir et facilité. Il donne un coup de main tout en s’entraînant!

description.english: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
description.french: La puissance et la rapidité de ses quatre bras puissants font des ravages sur ses adversaires.

description.english: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
description.french: Il préfère les climats chauds et humides. Ses lianes peuvent capturer une proie en un clin d’œil.

description.english: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
description.french: Un Pokémon végétal. Il capture les proies étourdies en les endormant à l’aide d’une poudre toxique.

description.english: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description.french: Sa bouche sécrète un fluide à l’odeur de miel, qui s’avère être un acide extrêmement corrosif.

description.english: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
description.french: Presque entièrement composé d’eau, son corps a tendance à se dessécher sur la terre ferme.

description.english: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
description.french: Ses 80 tentacules lui permettent d’emprisonner ses adversaires dans un redoutable filet venimeux.

description.english: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
description.french: Au repos, rien ne le distingue d’un vulgaire caillou. Malheur à ceux qui lui marchent dessus par mégarde!

description.english: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
description.french: Il dévale les montagnes pour se déplacer. Une fois qu’il a pris tout son élan, dur dur de l’arrêter!

description.english: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
description.french: Aucun explosif ne pourrait entamer sa carapace de pierre. Il mue une fois par an.

description.english: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
description.french: Chancelantes à la naissance, ses pattes deviennent très vite sûres et solides à force de galoper.

description.english: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description.french: Au grand galop, sa crinière de feu disperse au vent une myriade d’étincelles ardentes.

description.english: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
description.french: Bien que lent, c’est un pêcheur adroit qui utilise sa queue. Elle est insensible aux morsures.

description.english: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
description.french: Ce grand benêt connaît des éclairs de lucidité lorsque le Kokiyas de sa queue se met à mordre.

description.english: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
description.french: Plus la rotation de ses extrémités est rapide, plus la force du champ magnétique qu’il génère est grande.

description.english: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
description.french: Des groupes apparaissent si des taches solaires couvrent le soleil. Ils brouillent les télévisions.

description.english: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
description.french: Il ne peut pas vivre sans son légume, c’est pourquoi il le protégera au péril de sa vie.

description.english: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
description.french: Ses deux cerveaux semblent communiquer leurs émotions grâce à un lien télépathique.

description.english: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
description.french: Quand Doduo connaît cette étrange évolution, l’une de ses têtes se dédouble. Il atteint les 60 km/h.

description.english: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
description.french: Un habitant des icebergs. En mer, il utilise la corne sur sa tête pour briser la banquise.

description.english: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
description.french: Son corps est couvert d’un grand manteau blanc qui, dans la neige, le dissimule aux yeux des prédateurs.

description.english: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
description.french: Il est né d’un torrent de boue exposé aux rayons X de la lune. Il vit dans les ordures.

description.english: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
description.french: Son corps exsude un fluide toxique qui tue instantanément les plantes et les arbres au contact.

description.english: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
description.french: Il nage à reculons en ouvrant et en refermant ses deux coquilles. Il laisse traîner sa large langue.

description.english: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
description.french: Il se défend en fermant sa coquille et projette des piquants qui repoussent ses agresseurs.

description.english: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
description.french: Son corps composé de gaz toxique pourrait asphyxier n’importe qui en quelques secondes.

description.english: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
description.french: Il adore se tapir dans l’ombre et faire frissonner ses proies en leur touchant l’épaule.

description.english: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
description.french: Si vous croisez un regard inquiétant qui perce la nuit, c’est sûrement un Ectoplasma.

description.english: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
description.french: Il se nourrit des pierres qu’il rencontre en creusant le sol. Il peut creuser à 80 km/h!

description.english: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
description.french: Son grand nez lui permet de lire les rêves d’autrui. Il adore les songes amusants.

description.english: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
description.french: La vue de son pendule oscillant endort en trois secondes, même quand on vient de se réveiller.

description.english: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
description.french: Il creuse son terrier sur des plages sablonneuses. Ses pinces repoussent si on les brise.

description.english: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
description.french: Sa grande pince possède une puissance de 10 000 chevaux. Son poids la rend difficile à manier.

description.english: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
description.french: Il ressemble à une Poké Ball. Ce Pokémon dangereux peut exploser ou s’électrifier au toucher.

description.english: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
description.french: Il se laisse porter par les vents lorsque son corps est gonflé d’électricité à en éclater.

description.english: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
description.french: Ces six œufs communiquent par télépathie. Ils peuvent se réunir rapidement si on les sépare.

description.english: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
description.french: On l’appelle “jungle sur pattes”. Si une tête devient trop grosse, elle tombe et produit un Noeunoeuf.

description.english: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
description.french: Il pleure en pensant à sa mère disparue, et ses larmes résonnent dans son crâne creux.

description.english: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
description.french: Ce Pokémon sauvage possède des os depuis sa naissance. Il s’en sert pour combattre avec dextérité.

description.english: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
description.french: Ses pattes élastiques s’allongent, ce qui ne manque jamais de surprendre au premier combat.

description.english: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
description.french: Même le béton cède sous ses poings dévastateurs. Au combat, il s’essouffle au bout de 3 minutes.

description.english: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
description.french: Quand il déploie sa langue de près de deux mètres, sa queue s’agite. Elles seraient reliées entre elles.

description.english: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
description.french: Il flotte en retenant des gaz plus légers que l’air. Ceux-ci sont explosifs, en plus d’être fétides.

description.english: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
description.french: Il grandit en absorbant les gaz des détritus. Des triplés existent, bien qu’ils soient fort rares.

description.english: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
description.french: Ses puissantes charges pourraient démolir n’importe quel bâtiment. Dommage qu’il soit stupide.

description.english: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
description.french: La station debout a libéré ses pattes avant et l’a rendu plus intelligent, mais il est distrait.

description.english: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
description.french: Ce Pokémon très serviable distribue ses œufs hautement nutritifs aux humains et Pokémon blessés.

description.english: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
description.french: Il se cache derrière des lianes bleues recouvertes d’un fin duvet. Il est chatouilleux.

description.english: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
description.french: Il élève ses petits dans sa poche ventrale. Il attend d’être en lieu sûr pour les laisser jouer dehors.

description.english: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
description.french: Il niche à l’ombre du corail. Quand il se sent menacé, il disparaît dans un nuage d’encre opaque.

description.english: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
description.french: Son épine dorsale le protège. Ses os et ses nageoires sont très prisés en médecine traditionnelle.

description.english: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
description.french: Malgré son élégance quand il nage, ses coups de corne sont redoutables.

description.english: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.
description.french: En automne, à la saison des amours, il fait des réserves de graisse et arbore des couleurs chatoyantes.

description.english: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
description.french: Même amoché, son corps se régénère tant que le noyau rouge est intact. Le noyau s’illumine à minuit.

description.english: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
description.french: Un noyau rouge trône en son centre. Il envoie des signaux radio mystérieux vers le ciel nocturne.

description.english: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
description.french: En modifiant les molécules de l’air du bout de ses doigts, il parvient à créer un mur invisible devant lui.

description.english: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
description.french: À force de trancher des objets solides, les faux de ses bras sont très aiguisées.

description.english: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
description.french: Son cri ressemble à des paroles humaines. Mais nul n’est jamais parvenu à les comprendre.

description.english: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
description.french: Il fait tournoyer ses bras pour donner de la force à ses coups. Profitez-en pour filer!

description.english: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
description.french: Quand il respire profondément, des vagues de chaleur émanent de son corps et le rendent difficile à voir.

description.english: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
description.french: Il serre les proies dans ses pinces pour les trancher en deux. S’il n’y arrive pas, il les jette au loin.

description.english: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
description.french: Après avoir choisi sa cible, il fonce dessus tête baissée. Il est réputé pour sa nature violente.

description.english: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
description.french: Un vénérable Magicarpe peut franchir une montagne en utilisant Trempette. Mais c’est tout...

description.english: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
description.french: Quand il se laisse emporter par la rage, il ne se calme qu’après avoir détruit tout ce qui l’entoure.

description.english: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
description.french: Il aime naviguer en portant des humains et des Pokémon sur son dos. Il comprend le langage humain.

description.english: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
description.french: Il a la capacité de modifier sa structure cellulaire pour prendre l’apparence de ce qu’il voit.

description.english: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
description.french: Son ADN particulier lui permet de s’adapter très rapidement à son environnement.

description.english: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
description.french: Sa composition moléculaire est proche de celle de l’eau, ce qui lui permet de se liquéfier.

description.english: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
description.french: Face au danger, il fait appel à l’électricité pour dresser ses poils et lancer des décharges.

description.english: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
description.french: L’air qu’il inspire est chauffé par la glande enflammée de son corps, atteignant les 1 700 °C.

description.english: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
description.french: Ce Pokémon créé par des scientifiques peut arpenter librement le cyberespace.

description.english: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
description.french: Un Pokémon ramené à la vie par la science à partir d’un fossile. Il peuplait autrefois les mers.

description.english: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
description.french: On pense que ce Pokémon a disparu parce que sa coquille en spirale était devenue trop grosse.

description.english: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
description.french: On pense qu’il peuplait les plages il y a 300 millions d’années. Il est protégé par une coquille robuste.

description.english: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
description.french: On pense que ce Pokémon est venu sur la terre ferme pour suivre l’évolution de ses proies.

description.english: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
description.french: Un Pokémon qui arpentait le ciel au temps des dinosaures. Ses crocs sont pareils à des scies.

description.english: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
description.french: Une fois le ventre plein, il est trop amorphe pour lever le petit doigt. Sautez sur son ventre!

description.english: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
description.french: Un Pokémon Oiseau légendaire. Il peut provoquer des blizzards en gelant l’humidité de l’air.

description.english: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description.french: Un Pokémon Oiseau légendaire dont on dit qu’il vit dans les nuages d’orage. Il contrôle la foudre.

description.english: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
description.french: L’un des Pokémon Oiseaux légendaires. On dit que sa venue annonce l’arrivée du printemps.

description.english: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
description.french: On l’appelle “Pokémon mirage” en raison de sa rareté. On a découvert sa mue.

description.english: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
description.french: La météo change brusquement quand il est entouré d’une aura. On dit qu’il peuple les mers et les lacs.

description.english: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
description.french: On raconte qu’il vit quelque part en mer. Il guide les équipages naufragés jusqu’à la terre ferme.

description.english: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
description.french: Un Pokémon conçu en réorganisant les gènes de Mew. On raconte qu’il s’agit du Pokémon le plus féroce.

description.english: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
description.french: Nombre de scientifiques voient en lui l’ancêtre des Pokémon car il maîtrise toutes leurs capacités.

description.english: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
description.french: Il jauge la température et l’humidité grâce à la feuille sur sa tête. Il raffole des bains de soleil.

description.english: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
description.french: Le collier de bourgeons à son cou répand un arôme épicé qui vous donne du tonus.

description.english: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
description.french: Son souffle a l’incroyable capacité de ranimer les plantes et les fleurs flétries.

description.english: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
description.french: Ce Pokémon est un grand timide. Les flammes sur son dos s’intensifient lorsqu’il prend peur.

description.english: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
description.french: La chaleur de ses flammes intimide l’ennemi. Elles s’intensifient lorsqu’il se prépare à combattre.

description.english: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
description.french: Il attaque en projetant des flammes. Il se dissimule derrière les vagues de chaleur qu’il produit.

description.english: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
description.french: Il broie tout ce qu’il trouve avec ses mâchoires puissantes. Même son Dresseur doit s’en méfier.

description.english: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
description.french: Quand il mord, il ne lâche pas prise avant que ses crocs se brisent. Ils repoussent par la suite.

description.english: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
description.french: Ce Pokémon à l’air pataud est capable d’attaquer à la vitesse de l’éclair pour mordre sa proie.

description.english: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
description.french: Ce Pokémon très nerveux prend appui sur sa queue pour observer ses alentours.

description.english: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
description.french: La femelle s’enroule autour des petits pour les bercer. Il accule l’ennemi grâce à sa vitesse.

description.english: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
description.french: Il hulule chaque jour à la même heure. Dans certaines cultures, il incarne la sagesse.

description.english: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
description.french: Ses yeux sont capables de voir distinctement même quand il fait très sombre.

description.english: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
description.french: Il est si timide qu’il ne se déplace qu’au milieu d’un essaim. Il exprime ses émotions par l’odeur.

description.english: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
description.french: Il tire sa force de la lumière des étoiles. Plus il y en a et plus ses motifs dorsaux sont grands.

description.english: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
description.french: Il tisse une toile fine mais solide pour poser des pièges et se poste dans l’attente d’une proie.

description.english: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
description.french: Il attache un fil à sa proie avant de la libérer. Il s’en servira pour la retrouver, elle et ses amis.

description.english: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
description.french: La transformation de ses pattes en ailes a certes amélioré sa capacité à voler, mais pas à marcher.

description.english: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
description.french: Il envoie des décharges électriques positives et négatives du bout des antennes pour paralyser sa proie.

description.english: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
description.french: La lumière de Lanturn surgit des profondeurs. On le surnomme “étoile des profondeurs”.

description.english: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
description.french: Les poches électriques de ses joues sont encore petites, mais risquent de l’électrocuter.

description.english: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
description.french: On dit qu’il se déplace à dos d’étoile filante. Il se montre souvent quand on en voit.

description.english: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
description.french: Son corps est doux et élastique. Quand il commence à rebondir, on ne peut plus l’arrêter.

description.english: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
description.french: Il transforme les émotions positives des autres en bonheur qu’il stocke dans sa coquille.

description.english: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.
description.french: Il parcourt le monde pour distribuer de la joie aux êtres bons.

description.english: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.
description.french: Il mange des cactus en prenant soin d’éviter les bourgeons et les épines. Il ne tient pas en place.

description.english: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
description.french: Cet étrange Pokémon peut voir l’avenir et le passé. Il guette sans cesse la course du soleil.

description.english: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
description.french: Sa laine fournie enfle lorsqu’il accumule de l’électricité statique. Son contact peut choquer.

description.english: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
description.french: Sa queue s’allume lorsque sa laine se charge d’électricité. Il projette des poils électrifiés.

description.english: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
description.french: Le bout de sa queue brille avec intensité. Jadis, on s’en servait pour envoyer des signaux.

description.english: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
description.french: À la fin de la saison des pluies, il sort danser en plein air, attiré par la chaleur du soleil.

description.english: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
description.french: Sa queue à l’extrémité remplie d’huile fait office de flotteur et lui permet de ne pas couler.

description.english: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
description.french: Ses poumons peuvent contenir assez d’air pour lui permettre de passer une journée sous l’eau.

description.english: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
description.french: Il prend l’apparence d’un arbre pour éviter les attaques, mais il déteste l’eau et fuit la pluie.

description.english: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
description.french: Il rassemble ses pairs pour les commander. Il utilise son cri pour diriger Ptitard.

description.english: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
description.french: Il dérive avec le vent. Sa présence en nombre dans les champs et les montagnes annonce le printemps.

description.english: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
description.french: Il fleurit lorsque les températures remontent. Il flotte dans le ciel pour absorber les rayons du soleil.

description.english: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
description.french: Poussé par les vents saisonniers, il fait le tour du globe en semant des spores de coton.

description.english: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
description.french: Sa queue est aussi agile que ses mains. Il vit en haut des grands arbres.

description.english: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
description.french: Il tombe du ciel sans crier gare en matinée. On en croise énormément l’année suivant un été froid.

description.english: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
description.french: Les rayons du soleil lui donnent de l’énergie. Il est connu pour migrer vers les régions ensoleillées.

description.english: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.
description.french: La vitesse de ses ailes lui permet un vol stationnaire. Il surveille ainsi tout son territoire.

description.english: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
description.french: Sur la terre ferme, il couvre son corps d’un fluide toxique qui le protège de la déshydratation.

description.english: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
description.french: De nature placide, il a tendance à se cogner la tête contre les récifs et autres bateaux de passage.

description.english: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.
description.french: Sa fourrure est si sensible qu’il peut détecter les vibrations de l’air et prédire le temps qu’il fera.

description.english: When agitated, this POKéMON pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
description.french: Quand il s’expose à la lumière de la lune, ses anneaux brillent et il obtient un mystérieux pouvoir.

description.english: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
description.french: Quand il est en danger, il tente de semer ses poursuivants dans les chemins montagneux.

description.english: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
description.french: La morsure de Kokiyas a fait de lui un génie dont l’intelligence rivalise avec celle d’un prix Nobel.

description.english: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
description.french: Il fait peur aux aventuriers en pleine nuit et se nourrit de leur frayeur.

description.english: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
description.french: Quand il est seul, il ne se passe rien... Mais en groupe, il semble habité par un mystérieux pouvoir.

description.english: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.
description.french: Il cherche désespérément à cacher sa queue noire. Certains pensent qu’elle renferme un secret.

description.english: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
description.french: La tête qu’il a sur la queue dispose de son propre cerveau et lui permet de couvrir ses arrières.

description.english: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
description.french: Il ressemble à une pomme de pin. Sa carapace le protège des Pokémon Oiseaux qui le picorent par erreur.

description.english: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
description.french: Il est prisonnier d’une coquille d’acier. Ses yeux vigilants sont la seule partie visible de son corps.

description.english: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.
description.french: Son nid est un véritable labyrinthe qu’il creuse à l’aide de sa queue. Il sait à peine voler.

description.english: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
description.french: Il fend l’air et fond sur sa proie pour s’agripper à son visage et la frapper avec son dard.

description.english: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
description.french: On pense que son corps s’est transformé à cause du fer contenu dans la terre dont il se nourrit.

description.english: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
description.french: Son visage horrible fait fuir les petits Pokémon. Par contre, les femmes le trouvent mignon.

description.english: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
description.french: En dépit des apparences, c’est un grand timide. Quand il s’énerve, il mord de ses énormes crocs.

description.english: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
description.french: Il envoie ses piquants empoisonnés à la ronde. Sa forme sphérique en fait un piètre nageur.

description.english: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
description.french: Les yeux sur ses pinces servent à intimider l’ennemi avant de passer à l’attaque.

description.english: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
description.french: Il stocke des Baies sous sa carapace. Elles fermentent et produisent des jus délicieux.

description.english: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
description.french: Il défend vaillamment sa réserve de miel personnelle à grand renfort de coups de corne.

description.english: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
description.french: Ce Pokémon rusé agit parfois en équipe pour voler des œufs, l’un d’entre eux faisant diversion.

description.english: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
description.french: Il baigne ses griffes dans le miel pour les lécher. Chaque paire de pattes a un goût unique.

description.english: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
description.french: Il marque de ses griffes les arbres de son territoire qui portent des Baies ou des fruits.

description.english: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
description.french: Son corps est fait de magma. S’il cesse de bouger, il refroidit et durcit.

description.english: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
description.french: Sa température corporelle avoisine les 10 000 °C. Des flammes fusent des fissures de sa coquille.

description.english: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
description.french: Son nez très sensible détecte champignons, Baies et sources chaudes enfouis sous la glace.

description.english: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
description.french: Il est protégé du froid mordant par son épais manteau de fourrure. Ses cornes sont formées de glace.

description.english: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
description.french: On en trouve beaucoup dans les mers claires du sud. On dirait qu’il ne peut pas vivre en eau polluée.

description.english: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
description.french: Son puissant jet d’eau ne manque jamais sa cible, même quand il est au fond de l’eau.

description.english: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
description.french: Il adore se cacher dans les fissures de la roche. Il crache parfois de l’encre sur ses proies.

description.english: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
description.french: Il dépose sa nourriture dans sa queue enroulée. Il l’offre souvent aux gens égarés en montagne.

description.english: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
description.french: Il ignore royalement les Rémoraid qui s’accrochent à ses nageoires pour manger les restes qu’il sème.

description.english: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
description.french: Son corps est prisonnier d’une armure dure comme l’acier, mais il vole à plus de 300 km/h.

description.english: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
description.french: Il est assez évolué pour chasser en meute et communiquer par des séries de cris modulés.

description.english: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
description.french: En colère, il crache des flammes contenant une toxine qui peut causer des dégâts irréversibles.

description.english: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
description.french: Chacun de ses déplacements provoque des tourbillons. Il vit dans les grottes sous-marines.

description.english: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.
description.french: Il est fort malgré son aspect ramassé. Il n’a aucun mal à porter un humain adulte sur son dos.

description.english: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
description.french: Il attaque en se roulant en boule pour percuter l’ennemi. Il peut abattre une maison d’un seul coup.

description.english: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
description.french: Il a subi une mise à jour censée lui permettre d’explorer d’autres planètes... C’est un échec.

description.english: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.
description.french: Quiconque observe ses antennes ressent une sensation étrange, comme si leur centre l’attirait.

description.english: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
description.french: Il marque son territoire en maniant sa queue comme un pinceau. On dénombre plus de 5 000 marques.

description.english: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
description.french: Il est réputé pour sa combativité. Il se blesse toujours en défiant des ennemis plus grands.

description.english: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
description.french: Il combat en tournoyant comme une toupie. La force centrifuge décuple sa puissance destructrice.

description.english: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
description.french: Il goûte à tout du bout des lèvres. Elles gardent en mémoire ses goûts et ses dégoûts.

description.english: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
description.french: Un faible courant électrique circule entre ses cornes. Attention à ne pas y mettre la main!

description.english: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
description.french: Son sang est chaud comme du magma et la température de son corps peut atteindre 600 °C.

description.english: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
description.french: On raconte que les enfants élevés au lait d’Écrémeuh deviennent des adultes braves et robustes.

description.english: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.
description.french: Les œufs que pond Leuphorie sont un concentré de bonheur dont une bouchée suffit à apporter la joie.

description.english: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
description.french: On prétend qu’il est tombé avec la foudre. Il peut lancer des éclairs grâce aux nuages sur son dos.

description.english: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
description.french: On raconte qu’à chaque fois qu’il rugit, un volcan entre en éruption quelque part.

description.english: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
description.french: Il parcourt le vaste monde pour purifier les eaux polluées. Il accompagne le vent du nord.

description.english: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
description.french: Un Pokémon qui se nourrit de terre. Après avoir dévoré une montagne, il s’endort pour grandir.

description.english: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
description.french: Son corps est dur comme la pierre souterraine. Il file comme une fusée en expulsant des gaz.

description.english: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
description.french: Lorsqu’il est en colère, il abat des montagnes et enterre des fleuves. On doit alors modifier les cartes.

description.english: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
description.french: Il dort dans une faille des grands fonds. Ses battements d’ailes génèrent une tempête de 40 jours.

description.english: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
description.french: Ses plumes possèdent sept couleurs. On prétend que sa vue apporte la joie éternelle.

description.english: This POKéMON wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
description.french: Il a le pouvoir de voyager dans le temps. Cependant, on dit qu’il n’apparaît qu’en temps de paix.

description.english: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
description.french: Ses plantes de pieds sont couvertes d’épines lui permettant de marcher au mur et au plafond.

description.english: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
description.french: Il vit dans les jungles denses. Il saute de branche en branche pour approcher de sa proie.

description.english: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
description.french: Les feuilles sur ses bras peuvent trancher des troncs épais. C’est le meilleur combattant des jungles.

description.english: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
description.french: Ses câlins réchauffent car il renferme une fournaise. Il envoie des boules de feu à 1 000 °C.

description.english: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
description.french: Ce maître du coup de pied peut donner 10 coups par seconde. Ses cris aigus intimident l’ennemi.

description.english: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
description.french: Des flammes fusent de ses poignets et ses coups brûlent l’ennemi.

description.english: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
description.french: Il analyse le courant grâce à la nageoire sur sa tête. Il est assez fort pour soulever des rochers.

description.english: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
description.french: Ses jambes robustes lui donnent un bon appui, même dans la boue. Il dort enfoui dans la saleté.

description.english: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
description.french: Il peut traîner un grand bateau en nageant. Il assomme l’ennemi d’un grand coup de ses bras épais.

description.english: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
description.french: Un Pokémon très obstiné qui poursuit sa proie jusqu’à ce qu’elle soit épuisée.

description.english: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
description.french: Il traque ses proies en groupe. Il ne désobéira jamais aux ordres d’un bon Dresseur.

description.english: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
description.french: Il marche en zigzaguant et n’a pas son pareil pour trouver des objets dans l’herbe ou sous terre.

description.english: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
description.french: Il fonce sur sa proie à plus de 100 km/h. Mais il ne peut pas dévier sa course et loupe souvent sa cible.

description.english: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
description.french: Cible favorite des Pokémon Oiseaux, il tente de se protéger avec ses épines venimeuses.

description.english: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
description.french: Il attend d’évoluer dans son cocon de soie accroché aux branches et se nourrit d’eau de pluie.

description.english: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
description.french: Malgré les apparences, il est très agressif et attaque avec sa trompe quand on le dérange.

description.english: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
description.french: Rancunier, il n’oublie aucune des attaques subies dans le cocon et se venge une fois qu’il a évolué.

description.english: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
description.french: Il disperse un nuage de poudre toxique à chaque coup d’aile. Il aime les feuilles d’arbres urbains.

description.english: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
description.french: Il ressemble à une plante aquatique et fait la navette pour les Pokémon qui ne savent pas nager.

description.english: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
description.french: C’est un mauvais plaisantin. Quand il repère un pêcheur, il tire sur sa ligne pour le déranger.

description.english: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
description.french: Ses muscles se tonifient au son d’une musique entraînante. Il ne peut pas s’empêcher de danser.

description.english: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
description.french: Il ressemble à un gland pendu à une branche. Il adore effrayer les autres Pokémon.

description.english: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
description.french: Le son de sa flûte d’herbe déstabilise l’auditeur. Il vit au plus profond des forêts.

description.english: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
description.french: D’un coup de sa feuille éventail, il génère des bourrasques de 30 m/s capables de souffler une maison.

description.english: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
description.french: Ce Pokémon téméraire n’a pas peur d’affronter des ennemis puissants. Il vole en quête de climats chauds.

description.english: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
description.french: Il vole en cercle en quête d’une proie. Dès qu’il l’a repérée, il fond sur elle en un éclair.

description.english: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
description.french: Il utilise les courants ascendants pour planer en altitude. Son bec lui sert à transporter la nourriture.

description.english: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
description.french: Ce messager du ciel transporte petits Pokémon et œufs dans son bec en toute sécurité.

description.english: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
description.french: Quand ses cornes captent les ondes positives d’un Pokémon ou d’un humain, son corps se réchauffe.

description.english: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
description.french: Quand il sent la joie de son Dresseur, il se met à danser, débordant d’énergie.

description.english: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
description.french: Prêt à tout pour protéger son Dresseur, il peut créer un mini trou noir par sa seule force mentale.

description.english: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
description.french: Il semble patiner sur l’eau. Le parfum diffusé par le sommet de sa tête sert à attirer ses proies.

description.english: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
description.french: Des motifs en forme d’yeux ornent ses antennes. Ses 4 ailes l’aident à voler dans toutes les directions.

description.english: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
description.french: Le sommet de sa tête libère des spores empoisonnées. Il est dangereux de les inhaler.

description.english: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
description.french: Ses petits bras s’étendent quand il donne un coup de poing. Son talent égale celui d’un boxeur pro.

description.english: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
description.french: Il passe le plus clair de son temps affalé. Rien qu’à le voir, on a envie de bâiller.

description.english: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
description.french: Son cœur bat dix fois plus vite que la normale, c’est pourquoi il ne tient pas en place.

description.english: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
description.french: Le Pokémon le plus fainéant du monde. Il s’allonge pour économiser ses forces et contre-attaquer.

description.english: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
description.french: Il grandit sous terre et se repère grâce à ses antennes car ses yeux sont quasiment aveugles.

description.english: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
description.french: Il bouge si vite que l’œil a parfois du mal à le suivre. Ils se regroupent près de la sève des arbres.

description.english: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
description.french: Une carapace d’insecte laissée à l’abandon. On dit qu’il vole l’âme de celui qui regarde à l’intérieur.

description.english: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
description.french: En temps normal, son cri est pareil à un murmure. Effrayé, il atteint le volume d’un avion à réaction.

description.english: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
description.french: L’onde de choc provoquée par son cri peut renverser un camion. Il trépigne pour augmenter sa force.

description.english: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
description.french: Son hurlement s’entend à 10 km à la ronde. Ses orifices émettent toutes sortes de bruits.

description.english: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
description.french: Il fortifie son corps en fonçant sur des arbres épais. Son nid est entouré d’arbres abattus.

description.english: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
description.french: Il aime mesurer sa force à celle des plus grands Pokémon. Ses coups de paume peuvent projeter un camion.

description.english: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
description.french: Sa queue est plus rebondissante qu’une balle du même nom. C’est aussi une massue très puissante.

description.english: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
description.french: Face au danger, il se protège en augmentant son magnétisme et en attirant tout objet métallique.

description.english: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
description.french: Il poursuit tout ce qui bouge. On le voit parfois courir en cercle, chassant sa propre queue.

description.english: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
description.french: Les femmes Dresseurs raffolent de sa sublime fourrure. Il ne possède pas de nid.

description.english: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
description.french: À force de manger des gemmes, les yeux de ce Pokémon des grottes obscures sont devenus des joyaux.

description.english: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
description.french: Ses cornes forment une grande mâchoire attachée à sa tête. Elle peut broyer des barres de fer.

description.english: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
description.french: Il vit habituellement au cœur des montagnes. Affamé, il dévore parfois des rails et des voitures.

description.english: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
description.french: Il se nourrit du minerai de fer qu’il fore. Il défend son territoire en chargeant avec son corps d’acier.

description.english: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
description.french: Il creuse des galeries à travers la pierre avec ses cornes d’acier pour trouver le fer qu’il apprécie.

description.english: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
description.french: Son entraînement d’ermite lui permet de léviter par le seul pouvoir de la méditation.

description.english: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
description.french: Le jeûne lui permet de concentrer son esprit au point de déceler l’aura de ses adversaires.

description.english: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
description.french: Il améliore ses réflexes en stimulant ses muscles grâce à l’électricité dans sa fourrure.

description.english: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
description.french: Il libère l’électricité par sa crinière. Il crée un nuage d’orage pour appeler la foudre.

description.english: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
description.french: Il absorbe l’énergie des poteaux électriques et encourage ses amis avec des pompons d’étincelles.

description.english: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
description.french: Il encourage ses amis. Son corps produit plus d’étincelles quand il est en mauvaise posture.

description.english: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
description.french: Il communique avec ses pairs en allumant son postérieur la nuit. Il adore le doux parfum de Lumivole.

description.english: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
description.french: Il utilise son doux parfum pour aider Muciole à décrire des arabesques dans le ciel nocturne.

description.english: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
description.french: Plus le Rosélia est en bonne santé et plus son parfum est agréable et relaxant pour son entourage.

description.english: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
description.french: Il est principalement composé d’un estomac dont les sucs digestifs dissolvent tout ce qu’il avale.

description.english: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
description.french: Il avale tout en une bouchée. Ses follicules sécrètent des fluides toxiques qui endorment l’ennemi.

description.english: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
description.french: Il attaque en banc quand on menace son territoire. Ses dents aiguisées peuvent couler un navire.
