description.english: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
description.french: Ses crocs lacèrent des feuilles d’acier. Il nage à 120 km/h. On l’appelle “tyran des mers”.

description.english: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
description.french: Par beau temps, il se pose sur les plages pour jouer et rebondir. Il expulse de l’eau par son évent.

description.english: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
description.french: Le plus grand des Pokémon. Il peut plonger à une profondeur de 3 000 m en retenant son souffle.

description.english: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
description.french: Son dos bossu renferme une lave bouillonnante. Elle refroidit par temps de pluie, ce qui le ralentit.

description.english: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
description.french: Il porte des volcans sur son dos. Quand le magma remonte, il frissonne et entre en éruption.

description.english: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
description.french: Il tire son énergie du charbon qu’il brûle dans sa carapace et crache de la suie noire en cas de danger.

description.english: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
description.french: Il utilise sa queue comme un ressort et bondit partout. Chaque nouveau choc fait battre son cœur.

description.english: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
description.french: Les perles noires amplifient ses pouvoirs psy. Sa danse étrange lui permet de contrôler ses ennemis.

description.english: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
description.french: Les motifs sur leur fourrure sont propres à chaque Spinda. Son pas chancelant le rend difficile à viser.

description.english: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
description.french: Il creuse un trou conique dans le sable du désert et se terre en attendant qu’une proie trébuche.

description.english: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
description.french: Ses violents battements d’ailes génèrent des vagues d’ultrasons qui donnent mal au crâne.

description.english: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
description.french: Son puissant battement d’ailes provoque des tempêtes de sable. On l’appelle “esprit du désert”.

description.english: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
description.french: En stockant l’eau dans son corps, cet habitant du désert peut survivre 30 jours sans boire.

description.english: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
description.french: Il sort la nuit pour chasser. Il traque les proies épuisées après une journée dans le désert.

description.english: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
description.french: Il ne se sent à l’aise que dans un milieu propre et repousse la poussière avec ses ailes.

description.english: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
description.french: Il aime enlacer ses amis dans ses ailes cotonneuses et ronronner.

description.english: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
description.french: C’est le rival de Séviper depuis des générations. Ses griffes aiguisées sont son meilleur atout.

description.english: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
description.french: Le rival historique de Mangriff. Il affûte la lame de sa queue sur les rochers avant le combat.

description.english: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
description.french: On suppose qu’il est lié au cycle lunaire, car il ne sort que les soirs de pleine lune.

description.english: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
description.french: Le bruit court que cette nouvelle espèce vient du soleil. Il produit de la lumière en tournoyant.

description.english: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
description.french: Son corps glissant est difficile à attraper. On dit qu’il a été créé dans de la boue solidifiée.

description.english: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
description.french: Il défend férocement son territoire en déclenchant des secousses terribles.

description.english: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
description.french: Sa nature robuste lui permet de vivre sur n’importe quel terrain. Ses pinces ne lâchent jamais prise.

description.english: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.
description.french: C’est un voyou qui utilise ses pinces pour chasser les autres Pokémon hors de sa mare.

description.english: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
description.french: Il se déplace en tournoyant sur son pied. Ce Pokémon rare fut découvert dans de vieilles ruines.

description.english: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.
description.french: Une ancienne figurine d’argile qui s’est animée suite à son exposition à un rayon de lumière étrange.

description.english: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
description.french: Il vivait au fond de la mer il y a 100 millions d’années. La science a permis de le ressusciter.

description.english: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
description.french: Vit dans les hauts-fonds des mers chaudes. Il déterre sa proie du sable quand la marée se retire.

description.english: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
description.french: Un ancêtre Pokémon réanimé à partir d’un fossile. Il vivait en mer et chassait avec ses pinces.

description.english: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
description.french: Il a gagné la côte après son évolution. Une armure robuste recouvre son corps.

description.english: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
description.french: Ce Pokémon a peut-être un physique disgracieux, mais il est robuste et peut survivre dans très peu d’eau.

description.english: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
description.french: Ses splendides écailles aux couleurs de l’arc-en-ciel changent de teinte selon l’angle de vue.

description.english: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
description.french: Son aspect change avec la météo. On a récemment découvert que ses molécules étaient pareilles à l’eau.

description.english: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
description.french: Il change de couleur à volonté, mais le motif en zigzag qui orne son ventre reste le même.

description.english: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
description.french: Il aime le goût de la vengeance. Ils vivent en rangs sous les gouttières des gens vindicatifs.

description.english: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
description.french: Une poupée mue par la tristesse qui la ronge depuis qu’on l’a délaissée. Elle recherche son propriétaire.

description.english: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
description.french: Les cris des enfants l’amusent. Il effraie les moins sages d’entre eux en traversant les murs.

description.english: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
description.french: Il cherche des feux follets pour les avaler. Ce qui se passe alors dans son corps est un mystère.

description.english: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
description.french: À force de toujours manger le même fruit succulent, il en pousse à la base de son cou.

description.english: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
description.french: Ses cris se répercutent dans son corps creux avant d’exploser en notes mélodieuses et saisissantes.

description.english: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
description.french: La capacité de sa corne à sentir les catastrophes ayant trop attiré l’attention sur lui, il vit reclus.

description.english: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
description.french: Il se muscle en bousculant ses semblables lors de mêlées. Il raffole des fruits sucrés.

description.english: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
description.french: On dit que des groupes entiers de Stalgamin vivent en harmonie sous des feuilles gigantesques.

description.english: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
description.french: Il empêche ses proies de prendre la fuite en gelant instantanément l’humidité de l’air.

description.english: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
description.french: Il gagne la côte en roulant sur les blocs de glace car sa morphologie n’est pas adaptée à la nage.

description.english: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
description.french: Il fait souvent tourner des objets sur son museau pour connaître leur odeur et leur texture.

description.english: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
description.french: Il brise la glace avec ses grosses défenses. Sa graisse le protège du froid, mais aussi des attaques.

description.english: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
description.french: Il ne produit qu’une perle durant son existence. On raconte qu’elle amplifie les pouvoirs psychiques.

description.english: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
description.french: Il vit loin sous la mer. Il appâte les proies crédules avec sa queue qui rappelle un petit poisson.

description.english: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
description.french: Au printemps, son corps rose se fait plus vif sans que l’on sache pourquoi. Il vit au fond de la mer.

description.english: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
description.french: Un Pokémon rare aperçu lors d’une exploration sous-marine. Il n’a pas évolué depuis 100 millions d’années.

description.english: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
description.french: Un habitant des mers chaudes. On dit que le couple qui tombe sur ce Pokémon connaîtra l’amour éternel.

description.english: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
description.french: Il rêve de pouvoir voler un jour. Pour l’heure, il s’entraîne en sautant du haut des falaises.

description.english: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
description.french: Ses cellules ont commencé à changer dans sa robuste coquille. Il la perd en évoluant.

description.english: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
description.french: À force de rêver de pouvoir voler, sa structure cellulaire a évolué et il s’est vu pousser des ailes.

description.english: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
description.french: Il dialogue avec les siens par impulsions magnétiques. En bande, ils se déplacent à l’unisson.

description.english: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
description.french: Il est formé de deux Terhal soudés. Son corps de fer résiste à un choc avec un avion à réaction.

description.english: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
description.french: Il est né de la fusion de plusieurs Métang. Ses quatre cerveaux en font l’égal d’un superordinateur.

description.english: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
description.french: Tout son corps est fait de roche. S’il s’ébrèche au combat, il utilise des pierres pour le réparer.

description.english: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
description.french: Son corps est fait de glace datant de l’ère glaciaire. Il contrôle un air gelé de -200 °C.

description.english: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
description.french: Son corps invulnérable fut forgé par la pression souterraine durant des dizaines de milliers d’années.

description.english: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
description.french: Son corps est recouvert d’un duvet qui reflète la lumière et le rend invisible.

description.english: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
description.french: Un Pokémon très intelligent. Il peut voler plus vite qu’un avion à réaction en repliant ses ailes.

description.english: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
description.french: On dit qu’il a fait monter les eaux en causant des pluies diluviennes. Il somnolait dans une fosse marine.

description.english: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
description.french: Il dormait dans le magma souterrain depuis sa lutte féroce contre Kyogre, il y a longtemps de cela.

description.english: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
description.french: Il vit dans la couche d’ozone, au dessus des nuages. Il est invisible depuis le sol.

description.english: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
description.french: On raconte qu’une fois tous les mille ans, il a la capacité d’exaucer tous les vœux durant une semaine.

description.english: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
description.french: Il vient d’un virus extraterrestre arrivé avec une météorite et ayant subi une mutation génétique.

description.english: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
description.french: La coquille sur son dos est faite de terre. Plus il est en bonne santé, plus elle est humide.

description.english: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description.french: Il sait d’instinct où trouver une source d’eau pure. Il y transporte d’autres Pokémon sur son dos.

description.english: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description.french: Certains petits Pokémon peuvent naître sur son dos et y passer toute leur vie.

description.english: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
description.french: Il est très agile. Il fait toujours attention d’éteindre la flamme de sa queue avant de se coucher.

description.english: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
description.french: Il contrôle habilement l’intensité de la flamme de sa queue pour tenir ses adversaires à distance.

description.english: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
description.french: Ses techniques de combat inédites à base de pieds et poings enflammés sont redoutables.

description.english: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description.french: Malgré sa démarche maladroite et ses pertes d’équilibre, il bombe toujours fièrement le torse.

description.english: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description.french: La fierté du Prinplouf est si grande qu’il lui est impossible de vivre en groupe.

description.english: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description.french: S’il voit son honneur bafoué, il est capable de faire des ravages avec ses ailes tranchantes.

description.english: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description.french: La faiblesse des Étourmi les force à vivre en groupe, mais ils se chamaillent souvent.

description.english: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
description.french: Conscient de sa propre faiblesse, il vit toujours en groupe, piaillant bruyamment quand il est seul.

description.english: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
description.french: Il combattra sans relâche, même blessé. Il prend grand soin de sa mèche.

description.english: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description.french: Une étude a montré que les dents du Keunotor poussaient aussi vite que celles du Rattata.

description.english: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description.french: Les digues insubmersibles qu’il construit font le bonheur des habitants proches.

description.english: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
description.french: Quand il tombe du haut de ses petites pattes, ses antennes font un bruit de xylophone.

description.english: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description.french: Ses cris sont tellement variés qu’il existe un village où on organise des concours en leur honneur.

description.english: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description.french: Ses muscles génèrent un courant électrique lorsqu’ils travaillent. Il s’illumine en cas de danger.

description.english: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description.french: Le courant qui circule à la pointe de ses griffes est capable de faire perdre connaissance à ses proies.

description.english: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
description.french: Il est capable de voir à travers les murs pour chasser des proies ou retrouver ses petits égarés.

description.english: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description.french: Il est sensible aux variations de température et on dit qu’il fleurit quand il sent la chaleur du soleil.

description.english: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
description.french: Ses mains contenant chacune des toxines différentes sont capables d’asséner de puissants coups.

description.english: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
description.french: Il vivait dans la jungle il y a 100 millions d’années. Il abat un arbre d’un coup de tête.

description.english: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
description.french: Quand deux Charkos se rentrent dedans, leur crâne extrêmement épais les empêche de s’assommer.

description.english: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
description.french: Il est si bien protégé qu’il peut déguster Baies et herbe fraîche sans craindre de prédateurs.

description.english: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
description.french: En groupe, ils protègent leurs petits en formant autour d’eux une impénétrable muraille.

description.english: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.french: Nul ne sait comment il y parvient, mais il arrive toujours à se former une cape, où qu’il soit.

description.english: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
description.french: À l’évolution, son corps absorbe les matériaux à proximité et peut ainsi présenter divers aspects.

description.english: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
description.french: Il adore le nectar des fleurs mais n’en récolte pas lui-même. Il préfère en voler à un Apitrini.

description.english: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
description.french: Ce trio inséparable depuis la naissance récolte du miel pour satisfaire Apireine.

description.english: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
description.french: Ce Pokémon utilise des phéromones pour donner des ordres de combat aux larves dans son abdomen.

description.english: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description.french: Il arrive que deux Pachirisu se frottent les joues pour partager l’électricité qu’ils ont accumulée.

description.english: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
description.french: Il utilise ses deux queues comme une hélice pour se propulser sous l’eau et trancher les algues.

description.english: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description.french: Il chasse souvent près des ports de pêche où il sauve parfois les gens tombés à la mer.

description.english: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
description.french: Sa petite boule rose est nutritive et délicieuse. Les Étourmi en raffolent.

description.english: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
description.french: Sous un grand soleil, il ouvre ses pétales pour en absorber les rayons.

description.english: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
description.french: Un étrange liquide mauve s’échappe de son corps, ne lui appuyez pas dessus.

description.english: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
description.french: Ses gènes ont démontré qu’il avait jadis une carapace couvrant la totalité de son dos.

description.english: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
description.french: Ses queues jumelles sont si agiles et efficaces qu’il ne se sert que très rarement de ses bras.

description.english: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
description.french: Sa façon de flotter sans but au gré du vent lui a valu le surnom de “bouée des esprits égarés”.

description.english: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
description.french: Des nuées de Grodrive dérivent dans le ciel au crépuscule. Ils disparaissent dès qu’on les voit.

description.english: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
description.french: Ses oreilles repliées se déroulent avec une force capable de briser un gros rocher.

description.english: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
description.french: Il est capable de décocher de puissants coups de pied si on touche à ses délicates oreilles.

description.english: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
description.french: Pareil à une incantation magique, son cri n’est que très rarement source de joie.

description.english: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
description.french: Son cri profond peut invoquer une meute de Cornèbre. On l’appelle “le crieur de mauvais augure”.

description.english: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description.french: Il a tendance à planter ses griffes dans le nez de son Dresseur s’il n’a pas été nourri à temps.

description.english: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
description.french: Il plaque ses queues contre son dos pour paraître plus grand. Il soutient un regard des heures.

description.english: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
description.french: Quand il sautille, l’orbe qu’il a dans la bouche s’agite et tinte comme une cloche.

description.english: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description.french: Son derrière propulse un fluide nauséabond qui peut faire fuir les Pokémon dans un rayon de 2 km.

description.english: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description.french: Il attaque en projetant un liquide fétide du bout de sa queue. Mieux vaut l’attaquer par les airs.

description.english: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description.french: Certains scientifiques soutiennent que ce Pokémon était jadis aussi réfléchissant qu’un miroir.

description.english: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
description.french: Il apportait la pluie en créant un portail vers une autre dimension. Il était synonyme de bonne récolte.

description.english: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description.french: Adepte des climats secs, il régule son humidité en laissant couler ce qui ressemble à des larmes.

description.english: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
description.french: Il imite les mouvements et les expressions des autres pour comprendre leurs sentiments.

description.english: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
description.french: Ce Pokémon ne se sépare jamais de son petit caillou et a tendance à traîner dans les pieds des gens.

description.english: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description.french: Sa langue comparable à celle de l’homme lui permet d’imiter habilement le langage humain.

description.english: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description.french: Son mauvais comportement lui a valu d’être enchaîné à une Clé de Voûte par un mystérieux sortilège.

description.english: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
description.french: Malgré sa maladresse, son énorme gueule lui permet de lancer des attaques puissantes.

description.english: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
description.french: Toujours à la recherche d’objets brillants, il arpente les grottes pour constituer son butin.

description.english: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
description.french: On dit que lancé à pleine vitesse, il crée des lames de vent avec ses ailes pouvant trancher un arbre.

description.english: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
description.french: Obnubilé par sa quête incessante de nourriture, il oublie parfois qu’il en a caché dans sa fourrure.

description.english: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
description.french: Il a la faculté unique de visualiser les émotions telles que la joie ou la colère sous forme d’ondes.

description.english: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
description.french: Un spécimen bien entraîné peut sentir et identifier les émotions de quelqu’un à plus d’un kilomètre.

description.english: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description.french: Il peut obturer ses narines et traverser le sable comme un ver. Il vit en colonies de 10 individus.

description.english: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description.french: Facilement irritable, il ouvre ses mâchoires au maximum pour intimider ses adversaires.

description.english: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description.french: Il saisit sa proie avec les pinces de sa queue et lui injecte un poison. Il peut survivre un an sans manger.

description.english: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description.french: Fier et robuste, il met un point d’honneur à battre ses adversaires sans utiliser de poison.

description.english: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description.french: Son instinct de survie le pousse à ne pas se battre dans les règles. C’est une mascotte populaire.

description.english: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description.french: Quand il coasse, le poison stocké sous sa gorge est secoué, le rendant ainsi plus efficace.

description.english: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description.french: Il s’accroche aux arbres des marais et attire ses proies avec sa salive à l’odeur enivrante.

description.english: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
description.french: La ligne qui fait le tour de son corps stocke l’énergie solaire et brille dans la nuit.

description.english: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
description.french: Il rampe au fond de l’océan grâce aux nageoires de son torse. Le Lanturn est son rival.

description.english: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
description.french: On organise des excursions pour le voir surfer sur les vagues au côté des Rémoraid.

description.english: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
description.french: Curieux de rencontrer des gens, ils se rassemblent autour des traces de pas trouvées dans la montagne.

description.english: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
description.french: Il apparaît quand les fleurs des terres enneigées fleurissent et se retire quand elles se fanent.

description.english: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
description.french: L’évolution l’a rendu encore plus retors. Il communique en griffant des signes dans les pierres.

description.english: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
description.french: Des scientifiques ont essayé de faire évoluer un Magnézone en laboratoire, mais ce fut un échec.

description.english: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
description.french: Sa longue langue est couverte en permanence d’une épaisse couche de bave anesthésiante.

description.english: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
description.french: Il peut lancer des pierres à une vitesse saisissante en bandant et relâchant ses muscles en un éclair.

description.english: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description.french: Ses bras sont en fait des plantes qui s’attachent à tout ce qu’elles touchent et peuvent repousser.

description.english: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
description.french: Encaissant les attaques, il vient toucher l’ennemi de ses queues et lui inflige une forte décharge.

description.english: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
description.french: Quand il lance des boules de feu à plus de 2 000 °C, son corps est comme chauffé à blanc.

description.english: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
description.french: Il apprécie particulièrement les gens qui respectent les autres et évitent les conflits inutiles.

description.english: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
description.french: Doté de mandibules à la force colossale, il excelle pour mordre ses ennemis en plein vol.

description.english: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
description.french: Il utilise la photosynthèse comme une plante et a aussi tendance à éviter le combat à tout prix.

description.english: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
description.french: Il ajuste la température de son corps pour créer un vent de glace en gelant l’air qui l’entoure.

description.english: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description.french: Le plus petit courant d’air peut lui donner assez d’élan pour faire le tour du monde sans un coup d’aile.

description.english: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description.french: On a libéré un spécimen de sa prison glacée au bout de 10 000 ans. Il n’en revenait pas.

description.english: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
description.french: Il a été modifié pour être capable de travailler dans des dimensions parallèles, mais c’est un échec.

description.english: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description.french: Toujours prêt à protéger son prochain, il se bat férocement avec ses coudes en forme d’épées.

description.english: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
description.french: Il utilise sa force magnétique pour diriger trois petites unités appelées Mini-nez.

description.english: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description.french: Son corps se replie sur lui-même pour emprisonner les esprits perdus et les ramener chez eux.

description.english: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
description.french: On dit que Momartik gèle ses proies grâce à son souffle à -50 °C avant de les exposer dans sa tanière.

description.english: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description.french: Son corps parcouru d’électricité lui permet de prendre le contrôle de certains appareils ménagers.

description.english: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description.french: Quand il prit son envol, les hommes apprirent à résoudre les problèmes. Le savoir était né.

description.english: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description.french: Quand il prit son envol, les hommes apprirent à ressentir la joie et la peine. L’émotion était née.

description.english: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description.french: Quand il prit son envol, les hommes acquirent la détermination. La volonté était née.

description.english: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description.french: On dit que le temps s’écoule au rythme des battements de cœur de ce Pokémon légendaire de Sinnoh.

description.english: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description.french: On dit que la stabilité de l’espace est maintenue par le souffle de ce Pokémon légendaire de Sinnoh.

description.english: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description.french: Son corps est composé d’acier brut dont certaines parties ont fondu à cause de sa propre chaleur.

description.english: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description.french: On dit qu’il a créé des Pokémon à son image à partir de glace, de roche et de magma.

description.english: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description.french: Sa grande violence lui a valu d’être banni. Il observe les hommes en silence depuis le Monde Distorsion.

description.english: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description.french: Les nuits où le premier croissant de lune est visible, l’arc de sa queue se déploie de façon superbe.

description.english: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
description.french: Ce Pokémon des mers chaudes revient toujours à son lieu de naissance, peu importe la distance.

description.english: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
description.french: Il est né avec le pouvoir incroyable de créer des liens avec n’importe quel Pokémon.

description.english: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description.french: Menacé, ce Pokémon se protège en créant des cauchemars dans l’esprit de ses ennemis.

description.english: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description.french: Les fleurs qui couvrent son corps s’ouvrent quand il est câliné avec amour et perçoit de la gratitude.

description.english: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
description.french: On dit que son œuf a éclos dans le néant et qu’il est à l’origine de la création du monde.

description.english: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description.french: Un Pokémon qui amène la victoire. On dit que les Dresseurs qui le possèdent peuvent gagner n’importe quel combat.

description.english: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
description.french: Un Pokémon intelligent et très calme. Lorsqu’il a reçu suffisamment de lumière du soleil, il devient plus agile.

description.english: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description.french: Il court comme s’il glissait sur le sol. Il déroute l’ennemi par ses mouvements et l’assomme d’un coup de liane.

description.english: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description.french: Il peut paralyser l’ennemi d’un regard. Il amplifie l’énergie du soleil dans son corps.

description.english: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description.french: Il évite agilement les attaques ennemies et crache des boules de feu par le groin. Il aime griller des Baies pour les manger.

description.english: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description.french: Quand le feu dans son corps s’embrase, sa vitesse et son agilité augmentent. En cas d’urgence, il crache de la fumée.

description.english: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description.french: Il embrase ses poings avec les flammes sur son menton et cogne l’ennemi avec. C’est un Pokémon très solidaire.

description.english: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
description.french: Il combat avec le coupillage de son ventre. Il peut parer un assaut et immédiatement contre-attaquer.

description.english: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
description.french: L’apprentissage de sa technique de combat, qui utilise élégamment ses deux coupillages, est extrêmement rigoureux.

description.english: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
description.french: Il peut terrasser ses ennemis d’un coup de la lame enchâssée dans son armure, et les faire taire d’un seul regard.

description.english: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description.french: Ils stockent à manger dans leurs bajoues et font le guet indéfiniment. Ils se font des signes en remuant la queue.

description.english: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description.french: Il attaque en crachant les graines des Baies qu’il accumule dans ses bajoues. S’il voit un ennemi, il dresse la queue.

description.english: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
description.french: Il fait vaillamment face à des ennemis très puissants, mais il est intelligent et évite les combats trop inégaux.

description.english: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
description.french: Les poils qui entourent son corps comme un manteau sont extrêmement durs et amortissent les coups.

description.english: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
description.french: Il sauve les gens bloqués dans les montagnes par des tempêtes de neige. Ses longs poils le protègent du froid.

description.english: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description.french: Il vole les gens pour le plaisir, mais il est tellement mignon que ses victimes finissent toujours par lui pardonner.

description.english: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
description.french: Un Pokémon insaisissable. Son style et son pelage magnifique attirent de nombreux Dresseurs.

description.english: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
description.french: Il vit dans les forêts profondes. Manger la feuille qui pousse sur sa tête fait disparaître la fatigue.

description.english: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description.french: Il a un tempérament violent et se bat avec sa queue pleine d’épines. La feuille sur sa tête est très amère.

description.english: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
description.french: Quand il s’énerve, la mèche sur sa tête chauffe à 300 °C. Il s’en sert pour griller des Baies et les manger.

description.english: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
description.french: Il adore les aliments sucrés. Ils lui servent d’énergie pour alimenter le feu à l’intérieur de son corps.

description.english: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description.french: L’eau contenue dans la mèche sur sa tête est pleine de nutriments. Elle fait pousser les plantes avec vigueur.

description.english: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
description.french: Il stocke de l’eau dans les mèches de sa tête. Quand il est à sec, il se ravitaille en aspirant de l’eau par la queue.

description.english: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
description.french: Quand Munna mange un rêve, celui-ci est aussitôt oublié par le rêveur. Il lévite en permanence.

description.english: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description.french: La fumée qui sort de son front contient les rêves de nombreuses personnes et ceux de nombreux Pokémon.

description.english: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
description.french: Il suit scrupuleusement les consignes de son Dresseur, mais il a du mal à comprendre les ordres trop compliqués.

description.english: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
description.french: Aussi éloigné qu’il puisse se trouver, il parvient toujours à retourner auprès de son Dresseur.

description.english: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description.french: Le mâle intimide ses ennemis avec ses caroncules. La femelle vole mieux que le mâle.

description.english: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
description.french: Leur crinière scintille quand ils lâchent une décharge électrique. Ils se servent de ces scintillements pour communiquer.

description.english: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description.french: Il réagit à la vitesse de l’éclair. Lorsqu’il est en plein galop, on peut entendre le grondement du tonnerre.

description.english: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
description.french: Il a une oreille hexagonale. Son corps, compressé dans des strates profondes, est dur comme de l’acier.

description.english: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
description.french: Quand il est gonflé à bloc, ses cristaux orangés scintillent. Il cherche de l’eau souterraine dans les grottes.

description.english: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
description.french: Il comprime de l’énergie dans son corps, et ses attaques sont assez puissantes pour renverser des montagnes.

description.english: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description.french: Il vit dans les forêts sombres et les grottes. Il émet des ultrasons par le nez pour se diriger.

description.english: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
description.french: Il émet des ondes sonores de différentes fréquences par le nez. Certaines peuvent briser des rochers.

description.english: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
description.french: Il peut creuser à plus de 50 km/h et faire la course avec une voiture roulant sur le terrain qu’il creuse.

description.english: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description.french: Ses vrilles en acier peuvent transpercer des poutres en fer. Il est très employé dans la construction de tunnels.

description.english: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description.french: Il ausculte les gens avec ses antennes auriculaires pour juger de leurs émotions ou de leur santé.

description.english: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
description.french: Il combat avec une poutre. Quand il en arrive à transporter de lourds madriers sans problème, l’évolution est proche.

description.english: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description.french: Même une armée de catcheurs se jetant sur son corps hyper musclé ne le ferait pas ciller.

description.english: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description.french: On pense que la recette du ciment a été enseignée aux humains par un Bétochef il y a 2 000 ans.

description.english: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
description.french: Il prévient ses camarades du danger en faisant vibrer ses joues pour générer un signal d’alarme très aigu.

description.english: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description.french: Quand il fait vibrer la bosse sur sa tête, il provoque des ondulations dans l’eau, mais aussi des tremblements de terre.

description.english: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description.french: Il fait gicler un liquide paralysant des pustules sur sa tête, et attaque ses ennemis à coups de vibrations.

description.english: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description.french: Quand il noue sa ceinture, il devient plus puissant. Les Judokrak sauvages tressent leur ceinture avec des lianes.

description.english: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
description.french: Dans les montagnes où il s’entraîne, on peut l’entendre donner des coups de poing aux rochers et aux grands arbres.

description.english: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
description.french: Quand il éclot, Manternel lui coud son vêtement. Il dort en cachant son visage sous sa capuche.

description.english: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description.french: Dans les forêts où il vit, la végétation pousse bien car il transforme les feuilles mortes en engrais.

description.english: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
description.french: Quand il trouve de petits Pokémon, il leur coud des vêtements de feuilles en utilisant ses coupoirs et son fil adhésif.

description.english: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description.french: Sa morsure est très venimeuse. Elle paralyse même les grands Pokémon Oiseaux, ses prédateurs.

description.english: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description.french: Protégé par sa solide carapace, il fonce sur ses ennemis en roulant comme un pneu.

description.english: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description.french: Il accule l’ennemi par ses mouvements rapides et l’attaque avec ses cornes. Il ne s’arrête qu’au coup de grâce.

description.english: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
description.french: Si on l’attaque, il projette un nuage de coton. L’ennemi le confond avec lui, ce qui permet à Doudouvet de s’enfuir.

description.english: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
description.french: Il se faufile comme le vent par les espaces les plus étroits, en laissant une touffe de poils blancs.

description.english: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
description.french: Les feuilles sur sa tête sont très amères, mais elles remettent d’aplomb les corps les plus éreintés.

description.english: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
description.french: Même les Dresseurs confirmés ont du mal à faire éclore sa belle fleur. Un Pokémon apprécié des célébrités.

description.english: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
description.french: Les bleus et les rouges se détestent cordialement et se battent dès qu’ils s’aperçoivent. Un Pokémon très violent.

description.english: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
description.french: Il vit dans le sable des déserts. Le sable chauffé par le soleil empêche son corps de refroidir.

description.english: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
description.french: Ils vivent en petits groupes. La membrane qui couvre leurs yeux les protège du soleil.

description.english: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
description.french: Il ne laisse jamais échapper ses proies. Ses mâchoires surpuissantes peuvent broyer une voiture.

description.english: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
description.french: Quand le feu brûle dans son corps, il est tout excité et court partout. Quand le feu s’apaise, il s’endort.

description.english: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description.french: Il entretient des flammes à 1 400 °C dans son corps. De quoi détruire un camion-benne d’un coup de poing!

description.english: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description.french: Avec une danse et des sons saccadés, il fait fuir ses prédateurs, les Pokémon Oiseaux dévoreurs de graines de fleur.

description.english: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
description.french: Il peut facilement creuser son trou dans les pierres les plus dures grâce au liquide sécrété par sa bouche.

description.english: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description.french: Entre eux, les querelles de territoire sont fréquentes et violentes. Celui qui se fait briser son rocher a perdu.

description.english: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
description.french: Il remonte sa peau jusqu’à son cou pour se protéger. Elle a une constitution élastique qui absorbe les coups.

description.english: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
description.french: Ils se regroupent pour rosser ceux qui pénètrent sur leur territoire. Ils crachent un venin corrosif.

description.english: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
description.french: On dit qu’il parcourt toujours le même itinéraire parce qu’il a gardé la mémoire de la ville antique qu’il protégeait.

description.english: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description.french: Le motif de son masque est son visage quand il était humain. Parfois, il le regarde et se met à pleurer.

description.english: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description.french: Il paraît qu’il avale les gens et les transforme en momies. Il adore manger des lingots d’or.

description.english: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
description.french: Il a été recréé à partir d’un fossile préhistorique. Il peut plonger jusqu’à 1 000 mètres de profondeur.

description.english: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
description.french: Il vit sur terre et en mer. Ses bras surpuissants peuvent percer des trous dans la coque des paquebots.

description.english: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
description.french: On dit qu’il serait l’ancêtre de tous les Pokémon Oiseaux. Il ne sait pas voler et se déplace en sautant d’arbre en arbre.

description.english: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
description.french: Il s’envole après avoir pris de l’élan. Il est assez intelligent pour chasser ses proies en groupe.

description.english: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
description.french: Il aime les endroits mal tenus. Le gaz qu’il rote endort pendant une semaine.

description.english: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
description.french: Il étrangle ses ennemis avec son bras droit et les achève avec le gaz puant et empoisonné qu’il exhale par la bouche.

description.english: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
description.french: Il a le pouvoir de prendre l’apparence des autres. On dit qu’il se transforme souvent en petit enfant silencieux.

description.english: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
description.french: Ces Pokémon protègent les leurs en prenant l’apparence de leurs ennemis. Ils forment des groupes très soudés.

description.english: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
description.french: Ils se saluent en se caressant mutuellement le corps avec la queue, qu’ils gardent toujours immaculée.

description.english: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
description.french: Leurs poils blancs sont recouverts d’une graisse spéciale qui leur permet d’esquiver facilement les attaques.

description.english: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description.french: Concentre des pouvoirs psychiques dans ses antennes semblables à des rubans, et regarde fixement... mais quoi?

description.english: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
description.french: Hypnotise les Pokémon et les gens. Il y a de nombreuses légendes de gens enlevés dans leur sommeil par des Mesmérella.

description.english: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description.french: Ses pouvoirs psychiques plient l’espace aux alentours. On y voit des étoiles éloignées de millions d’années-lumière.

description.english: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description.french: Ils repoussent leurs assaillants avec leurs pouvoirs psychiques et communiquent entre eux par télépathie.

description.english: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description.french: Il possède deux cerveaux séparés qui le font parfois agir de façon totalement incohérente.

description.english: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description.french: Quand ils se tiennent par la main, leurs cerveaux forment un réseau qui démultiplie leurs pouvoirs psychiques.

description.english: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
description.french: Un Pokémon Oiseau doué pour la plongée. Il nage sous l’eau à la recherche de sphaigne, son plat préféré.

description.english: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description.french: Ils se mettent à danser à la tombée de la nuit. Le Lakmécygne qui danse au centre est le chef de la troupe.

description.english: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
description.french: Il exhale une haleine à -50 °C. Il fabrique des cristaux de neige et fait neiger autour de lui.

description.english: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
description.french: Un Pokémon qui vit dans les montagnes enneigées. Il a émigré au sud durant l’ère glaciaire, il y a bien longtemps.

description.english: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
description.french: Il avale de l’eau en grande quantité et la transforme en nuages neigeux. Il souffle du blizzard sur ses ennemis.

description.english: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
description.french: Son pelage prend la même couleur et la même odeur que les hautes herbes. S’il sent un ennemi, il court s’y réfugier.

description.english: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
description.french: Il change d’habitat selon les saisons. Les gens constatent le passage des saisons en regardant ses ramures.

description.english: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
description.french: Il accumule dans ses membranes l’électricité qu’il produit dans ses bajoues, et la relâche tout en planant.

description.english: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description.french: Un Pokémon mystérieux qui évolue quand il reçoit un stimulus électrique en étant proche d’un Escargaume.

description.english: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
description.french: Il vole à toute vitesse et frappe tout ennemi de ses lances pointues. Il combat bravement contre les plus forts que lui.

description.english: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description.french: Grâce à sa ressemblance mystérieuse avec une Poké Ball, il attire ses ennemis et relâche des spores empoisonnées.

description.english: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
description.french: Il danse en faisant tournoyer les coupoles en forme de Poké Ball de ses bras pour attirer ses proies.

description.english: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
description.french: Il s’enfonce dans les profondeurs de la mer en emmenant son ennemi, qu’il ligote avec ses bras fins comme des voiles.

description.english: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
description.french: Les bateaux qui s’aventurent sur son territoire coulent, et Moyade aspire l’énergie vitale des marins.

description.english: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
description.french: La membrane spéciale qui entoure son corps a la capacité de guérir les blessures.

description.english: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
description.french: Les Statitik qui vivent en ville ont appris à aspirer le courant depuis les prises électriques des maisons.

description.english: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description.french: Quand on l’attaque, il projette une multitude de fils électrifiés pour créer une barrière électrique.

description.english: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description.french: Quand il sent un danger, il réagit en projetant toutes ses épines d’un coup et s’enfuit en roulant sur lui-même.

description.english: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
description.french: Il combat avec ses trois tentacules épineux. Un coup de ses épines d’acier peut briser en deux de gros rochers.

description.english: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description.french: La compatibilité entre ses deux rouages est prédéterminée. Ceux-ci ne se fixeront à aucun autre.

description.english: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description.french: Ils communiquent entre eux en changeant leur sens de rotation. Plus ils sont en colère, plus ils tournent vite.

description.english: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
description.french: Son noyau rouge lui permet d’accumuler de l’énergie qu’il projette ensuite aux alentours grâce à ses pics.

description.english: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description.french: Tout seuls, ils ne dégagent pas beaucoup d’électricité, mais un banc d’Anchwatt produit la même puissance qu’un éclair.

description.english: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
description.french: Ses taches rondes émettent de l’électricité. Il s’enroule autour de ses proies et les électrocute.

description.english: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description.french: Il peut sortir de l’eau à la force de ses bras pour attraper des proies sur la rive. Il retourne à l’eau en un instant.

description.english: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
description.french: Avec son puissant pouvoir psychique, il peut compresser le cerveau de ses ennemis et déclencher des migraines.

description.english: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
description.french: Il peut manipuler les souvenirs de ses ennemis et fait clignoter ses doigts tricolores pour discuter avec ses amis.

description.english: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description.french: Sa flamme brûle en consumant l’énergie vitale des gens et des Pokémon.

description.english: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
description.french: Un Pokémon craint pour être de mauvais augure. Il erre dans les villes à la recherche d’âmes de défunts.

description.english: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
description.french: Il brûle en aspirant les âmes, et hypnotise ses ennemis en faisant osciller les flammes de ses bras.

description.english: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description.french: Il broie les Baies à grands coups de crocs. Ceux-ci repoussent plusieurs fois, toujours plus forts et aiguisés.

description.english: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
description.french: Comme ses crocs brisés ne repoussent pas, il les aiguise après le combat grâce à une pierre ramassée près d’un fleuve.

description.english: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
description.french: Il est doux, mais ne pardonne pas à ceux qui viennent saccager son territoire. Ses crocs peuvent découper de l’acier.

description.english: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
description.french: Quand il est malade, sa goutte au nez dégèle et ses capacités de type Glace deviennent moins efficaces.

description.english: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
description.french: Il fait lui-même geler son haleine. Il est bon nageur et sillonne les mers du nord à la recherche de ses proies.

description.english: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
description.french: Si sa température monte, il se dissipe en vapeur d’eau et disparaît. Quand elle diminue, il redevient de glace.

description.english: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
description.french: Quand on l’attaque, il referme sa visière pour se défendre, et projette un poison visqueux.

description.english: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
description.french: Quand son corps s’assèche, il faiblit. Il s’en prémunit en s’enroulant dans plusieurs couches d’une fine muqueuse.

description.english: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
description.french: Sa peau est si dure qu’il peut se faire piétiner par un sumo sans rien sentir. Il sourit en émettant de l’électricité.

description.english: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
description.french: Il découpe ses ennemis avec ses griffes acérées et les terrasse avec ses enchaînements de coups hyper fluides.

description.english: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
description.french: Il se sert des poils de ses pattes antérieures comme de fouets. Ses coups ultrarapides sont invisibles à l’œil nu.

description.english: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
description.french: Il utilise ses ailes pour emmagasiner la chaleur du soleil. Si la température de son corps baisse, il ne peut plus bouger.

description.english: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
description.french: Il se meut grâce à l’énergie stockée dans son corps. Personne ne sait d’où vient cette énergie mystérieuse.

description.english: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
description.french: Il vole à la vitesse du son. Si le sceau sur sa poitrine est retiré, il perd tout contrôle de lui-même.

description.english: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
description.french: Tout son corps est fait de lames. Si une lame s’émousse, il va l’aiguiser contre une pierre au bord d’une rivière.

description.english: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
description.french: Ils dirigent les groupes de Scalpion. Ils se battent pour la suprématie sur le groupe, et les perdants en sont exclus.
