description.english: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

description.english: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
description.french: Description non disponible.

description.english: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

description.english: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

description.english: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
description.french: Description non disponible.
